date_note: Techgear.gr, relaying Cybernews, gives only its own publication day for the leak post.
exec: A group claims it published GoDaddy internal data; GoDaddy says it is investigating.
plain: A newly emerged group called Inception says it leaked internal GoDaddy data. GoDaddy has not confirmed the material is authentic and says it has started an internal investigation.
summary: Techgear.gr, citing Cybernews, reports that the Inception ransomware group posted a data package on its leak site that it claims is from GoDaddy. Per the article, a GoDaddy spokesperson told Cybernews the company knows of the post and has started an internal investigation; GoDaddy has made no public statement confirming authenticity.
title: Claim: Inception ransomware group says it leaked GoDaddy internal data

validation.note: Single publisher read (Techgear.gr, relaying Cybernews); the Cybernews original returned 403 and could not be read.

review.note: Compared claim wording, GoDaddy investigation statement, claimed severity 1 against Techgear.gr
